hepatotoxicity.description: Curated potential for drug-induced liver injury, applied by app.core.safety.check_hepatotoxic_burden. 'dose_dependent' is intrinsic toxicity (predictable from exposure); 'established' is a well-documented idiosyncratic signal in the published DILI registries. ABSENT means 'not curated here', NOT 'safe for the liver' — the check counts an absent tier as contributing nothing rather than as a clean drug, and says so in its output.

renal_threshold.description: eGFR band in mL/min. Applied by app.core.safety._evaluate_renal.

hepatic_threshold.description: Liver-function thresholds, applied by app.core.safety._evaluate_hepatic. A rule naming both markers is breached by EITHER. Only these marker keys are evaluated: a threshold written on any other key can never fire, which is the failure the evaluator was added to end — tests/test_hepatic_dose_adjustment.py holds this file to it.

action.description: 'contraindicated' is a hard block; anything else is a warning.
